The decisive facts are that no policy verdict exists and coverage is incomplete: the healthy-looking latency and zero-error figures cannot be read as PASS, as spare capacity, or as evidence that nothing is wrong. RESOURCE_GAPS means resource-side samples are missing, so no capacity bound, saturation, or load-level conclusion is supportable from this bundle, and the ~12x gap between max (904 ms) and p99 (77 ms) is an unexplained upper tail that this overall-scope summary cannot localize. Next steps are operator actions: configure the missing policy (or required capacity) and rerun so a PASS/FAIL determination can exist, close the resource gaps by re-collecting with resource monitoring attached, inspect the raw JTL for the maximum-latency sample and per-transaction detail, and verify assertion/response-code capture before treating error_count 0 as "no failures". Advice here does not alter the deterministic verdict; NO_POLICY remains NO_POLICY regardless of observed metric health or a rerun with a fixed generator.

hypotheses.observation: The referenced fact analysis-result.json#/policy_verdict is NO_POLICY, while the referenced overall metric summary reports error_rate_ratio 0/2623 and latency_ms p50 11, p95 46, p99 77, max 904.
hypotheses.possible_explanation: No evaluation policy (or no required capacity input) was configured for this run scope, so the analyzer had nothing to judge the observed metrics against. Under the product rules, a missing policy or missing required capacity yields NO_POLICY; favorable latency and zero recorded errors cannot convert it to PASS.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Inspect the policy configuration associated with this run/transaction set and confirm which thresholds (latency, error rate, throughput) or required-capacity inputs are absent. Configure them and rerun; only a configured policy or required capacity can produce PASS or FAIL.

hypotheses.recommended_check: Open the coverage record and enumerate which resource streams/hosts were expected versus present, then re-collect the run with resource monitoring attached and continuous. Re-check coverage status before drawing any capacity conclusion.

hypotheses.observation: In the referenced overall metric summary, latency_ms max is 904 while p99 is 77, p95 is 46, and p50 is 11 — the maximum is roughly an order of magnitude above p99.
hypotheses.possible_explanation: A small number of unusually slow samples sit far above the central distribution. The overall-scope summary alone cannot distinguish these, and no findings were emitted to corroborate any of them.
